statement: Papa Kartari Yoga (the Ascendant 'hemmed' on both sides -- 2nd and 12th houses -- exclusively by natural malefics) is traditionally read as carrying obstruction and isolation from support — the self cut off from the chart's beneficial resources on either side, the negative mirror of Shubha Kartari.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
